Exactly SIX UNIQUE whole UPRIGHT FOOTLESS ink blob cartoon-claymation monsters,3columns2rows,landscape1536x1024 transparent PNG. Reference1 original veteran STYLE ONLY for continuous rounded dark ink body/material;reference2 original RPG STYLE ONLY for rich sculpted prop/costume craft,NOT cloned expressions/red eyeballs/source identities. No previous generated sheet as style parent. Charcoal-black thick goo with deep violet sheen,round asymmetric splat lobes,few round ink droplets,short goo hands,huge expressive face directly in continuous body. Complete upright camera-facing FOOTLESS ink blobs,no human torso,legs,feet,cropped bust,stone human statues or robot/animal bodies. Rich soft modeled plasticine,fine fingerprints,wood/metal/fabric/clay prop craft,not angular stone/noisy patches or glossy generic Pixar people. Exactly TWO female-read via subtle lids/lashes/headgear,not human anatomy. WHITE/IVORY sclera,RED iris,BLACK pupil;thick fully colored violet lids,eyes unobscured. Dark ink-colored lips,no pink human lipstick. Teeth only from INSIDE upper gum down into mouth,never on outer lower lip;closed mouths toothless. Six own strong silhouettes,gazes,mouths,poses/emotions,not six angry grins. A few simple readable coherent props,not clutter or dysfunctional giant contraptions. Costumes small collars/panels only,whole goo body dominant. No extra living creatures/characters/puppets. Philosophers free surreal archetypal echoes,not scientific diagrams or exact historical likenesses.
FAMILY: Hero Set 01, deck inspiration platos_dungeon_raid_hero_set_01.
TOP LEFT — Dialogbardin Gegenstimme, weiblich-read. Bard of Dialogues: tall pear ink splat,little berry feather cap ABOVE eyes,two lashes,tiny cream collar,ONE small three-string lute with clearly modeled round body held at flank. Wide delighted asymmetric singing mouth with THREE upper teeth,one eye nearly winking. Personality: Can turn an argument into a duet before either side has agreed.
TOP MIDDLE — Paladin Mustergültig, maennlich-read. Paladin of Virtue: broad low square rounded splat,small brass OPEN-FACE knight cap above eyes,two tiny shoulder plates,ONE little shield with plain golden sun emblem and short blunt ceremonial sword pointed safely down beside body. Severe unequal lids,huge closed toothless righteous pout. Personality: Protects the good so carefully that it struggles to get outside.
TOP RIGHT — Skeptiker Hinterfragt, maennlich-read. Rogue Skeptic: lean hooked comma blob,small dark teal rogue hood pulled BACK clear of eyes,tiny belt pouch,ONE short magnifying glass and little brass lockpick held apart. Huge uneven eyes examining glass,tiny off-centre toothless triangular open mouth. Personality: Distrusts the obvious entrance and has questions about the exit.
BOTTOM LEFT — Formenmagier Urbild, maennlich-read. Wizard of Forms: round top-heavy ink splat,small plum pointed cap with one plain geometric badge not stars everywhere,ONE short wand topped by smooth ivory cube and little closed sketchbook. Intense triumphant crooked open grin with TWO upper teeth,one eyebrow high. Personality: Summons the perfect version and finds the room insufficiently prepared.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Orakelklerikerin Schongewusst, weiblich-read. Cleric of the Oracle: tall broad-based lopsided blob,small cream ritual headband with copper disk,two lashes,tiny teal shoulder cloth,ONE shallow brass divination bowl holding THREE small ivory pebbles. Bored omniscient unequal lids,closed toothless wavy mouth. Personality: Saw this coming and would still like everyone to be more specific.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Barbar Unverblümt, maennlich-read. Barbarian Cynic: squat broad asymmetrical ink splat,tiny ragged russet fur shoulder strip only,small hornless leather cap,ONE short chunky wooden club with smooth blunt head and battered empty tin cup at flank. Huge irreverent open laugh with ONE large upper tooth,one cheek raised. Personality: Has reduced the entire debate to a practical objection.
